svg.aria-label: Doom's P_Random reads the next entry of a fixed table of 256 bytes through an index that wraps around, so one extra call shifts every later number and breaks a demo
svg.title: Doom's P_Random reads the next entry of a fixed table of 256 bytes through an index that wraps around, so one extra call shifts every later number and breaks a demo
svg.text: P_Random returns table[index] and adds one to the index. The index goes back to 0 after 255.
the 256 entries, numbered 0 to 255; the index runs off the end and starts again at 0
A port with one extra call
Every call after the extra one reads a different number, so the demo goes out of sync. The port must keep the order of calls.
